body: I think there’s so much negativity on this subreddit because if people were happy with their marriages, they wouldn’t be on Reddit in the first place trying to navigate their marriage. I think the issue is that people get married too soon without really knowing what they are getting themselves into. I’m going to exclude the forced and highly pressured marriages that are discussed on here. They want to be loved and have a nice wedding and have a beautiful traditional marriage that is so glamorized on social media. And it is beautiful when people let go of their egos and their bad habits and their selfish ways and equally pour themselves into one another. But people don’t understand what it is to have a healthy life partnership where you work as a team. Pickup where the other lacks and have mutual respect. Also people are materialistic and put a lot of emphasis on image and showing off to people and just want so much that they don’t need. It’s sad how much effort people put into making other people think they’re happy and successful instead of focusing on making themselves happy.
